## Props

- `name: ReactNode`
- `description?: ReactNode`
- `status?: ReactNode` - Footer badge label, e.g. `Live`.
- `statusVariant?: BadgeStatus` - Which status pair the footer badge renders. Defaults to `active`.
- `tags?: string[]` - Neutral outlined pills in the footer, e.g. `['Figma', 'Chrome']`.
- `people?: string[]` - Initials of the people on it, rendered as an `sm` avatar stack.
- `gates?: RoadmapGate[]` - Named approvals the item still has to clear.
- `gatesLabel?: ReactNode` - Heading above the gate chips. The source's copy is the default.
- `accentColor?: string` - Any CSS color for the 3px left stripe - the real `--card-color` the roadmap sets per tool (`#3694FC` audit, `#00E2A0` convert, `#B98FFF` handoff, `#36EAD0` parity).
- `highlight?: boolean` - The source's `.card.highlight`: a blue-tinted fill and ring.
- `children?: ReactNode` - Extra body content - a callout, a nested list - after the description.
- `id?: string` - Anchor id, so a DocRail section link can jump to this item.
- `className?: string`
- `style?: CSSProperties`
